subject: EmeraldEdge subprocessor roster + EU routing / KMS confirmation
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@emeraldedge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@emeraldedge.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + EU routing / KMS questions

Hi Hannah,

As part of our upcoming vendor security review (SOC2 scope update), our security team has asked for the most recent list of Redwood subprocessors and clarification on two items specific to our EU tenant:

1) Does any production data for EU customers transit through third-country processors outside the EEA? If so, which processors and what safeguards are in place?

2) For customer-managed encryption keys (KMS), can you confirm whether Redwood supports a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) flow for EU-dedicated customers and whether any HSM providers are used in the cryptographic path?

Attached is our standard questionnaire — it's short. If we can get a CSV roster and answers to the two items above by end of week that would help our audit timeline.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Head of Security Operations
EmeraldEdge Inc.

Attachment: emeraldedge_subprocessor_questionnaire.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@emeraldedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + EU routing / KMS questions

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Kimberly (security) and Ben (infrastructure) to provide the roster and the technical details. A couple of quick notes from my side:

- We'll provide a CSV with current subprocessors and a short data-flow note.
- Regarding EU routing, we have regional routing policies that prefer EEA egress for EU customers; there are a small set of telemetry and observability vendors that may ingest aggregated metrics outside the EEA for operational analytics — we'll call those out explicitly.
- For BYOK/KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; we'll confirm the exact HSM partners and the path used.

Ben/Kimberly — could you review the attached questionnaire and drop the CSV + short answers to Oliver? If we can get a draft by EOD Thursday (2026-06-10) that would keep EmeraldEdge's audit on track.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@emeraldedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + EU routing / KMS questions

Hi all — attaching the current subprocessor inventory CSV and a brief summary below. See attached: redwood_subprocessors_20260609.csv (columns: provider, role, countries, data_types, legal_basis).

Summary (short):
- Primary serving: self-hosted runtime on GCP (us-west/eu-west regions) + partner GPU providers for burst capacity. Production inference for EU tenants is routed to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 by default.
- Cross-border notes: Observability metrics and aggregated telemetry (no PII) are forwarded to our analytics partner AnalyticsLink (US) under contract — we mark that in the CSV and include SCCs. For EEA-restricted customers we can disable non-essential telemetry forwarding.
- KMS/BYOK: For Dedicated and Private customers we support BYOK using AWS KMS or customer HSM via an HSM abstraction layer. HSM partners we work with: CloudHSM (AWS) and Thales Luna for on-prem customers (HSMs are used for key storage only; cryptographic operations remain within customer-controlled bounds where BYOK is enabled).
- DPA amendment: We have a short DPA addendum draft for subprocessor updates which I attached (redwood_dpa_amendment_draft.docx). If EmeraldEdge needs DocuSign, we can generate a DocuSign envelope once legal confirms the language.

If you'd like a short call with infra/security to go through the CSV and routing map we can do 30 mins tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Infrastructure Security Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20260609.csv, redwood_dpa_amendment_draft.docx
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@emeraldedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@emeraldedge.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 20:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + EU routing / KMS questions

Ben / Hannah — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Quick confirmations:

- We received the CSV and have flagged AnalyticsLink in our review — please confirm the SCC copy and the contact at AnalyticsLink (we'll loop them into our review).
- BYOK flow sounds fine; we'd like a short diagram showing key provisioning steps and what Redwood stores/does not store when BYOK is enabled (can Ben provide?).
- Please go ahead and generate the DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum and cc our legal team (legal@emeraldedge.com).

If possible, we prefer the diagram + DocuSign before EOD Monday (2026-06-14) so we can close this item before our auditor visit. Happy to take a 20-minute sync if that helps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Head of Security Operations
EmeraldEdge Inc.
